Backup.Folder.Overlaps: Choose a folder outside the settings folder, its subfolders, and its parents.
Backup.Folder.InvalidPath: The sync folder path is invalid.
Backup.SyncReason.NotConfigured: Sync is off, no sync folder is set, or device state is read-only.
Backup.SyncReason.FileAccess: Couldn't read or write files. Check the connection and permissions.
Backup.SyncReason.MissingFolder: The sync folder couldn't be found.
Backup.SyncReason.Future: Can't overwrite settings from a newer version. Update Snapwell.
Backup.SyncReason.LocalBroken: Sync was skipped because this PC's settings are damaged.
Backup.SyncReason.RemoteBroken: The settings in the sync folder are damaged.
Backup_Lead.Text: Share hotkeys, grids, gaps, feel, and rules across PCs. Startup, Windows features, and sync folder choices apply only to this PC.
Backup_CloudHint.Text: Snapwell does not send settings to the cloud. Your file sync service, such as OneDrive or Dropbox, copies files in the sync folder to other PCs. Changes arrive only after that service finishes syncing.
Backup_ExportDescription.Text: Save settings in one JSON file.
Backup_ImportDescription.Text: Review differences before importing. Replace all settings or import selected items.
Backup_SaveHint.Text: After importing, use Save at the bottom to apply.
Backup.Error.FutureDevice: This device state is from a newer version, so sync choices can't be changed.
Backup.Error.LoadDevice: Couldn't read device sync settings. Check permissions.
Backup.Error.FutureSettings: Can't sync settings from a newer version. Update Snapwell.
Backup.Error.SaveChoice: Couldn't save sync choices. Check permissions.
Backup.Transfer.Failed: Couldn't complete the file operation. Check the file location and permissions.
Backup.Transfer.Imported: Imported into this page. Use Save at the bottom to apply.
